settings.question: How do I use a concentrate?
settings.answer: Blend the 30ml concentrate into 150ml of your regular base oil (coconut, sesame or almond) — or 50ml into 250ml. Same 1:5 ratio. Shake well before each use.

settings.question: Can I apply it directly?
settings.answer: Yes. For targeted, high-potency use, apply a few drops directly to the scalp and massage in circular motions. Leave in for at least 30 minutes or overnight before washing.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Use 2–3 times a week for visible results within 4–6 weeks.
